risks.risk: Incomplete bundle (missing HDMI cable or other required accessories) affecting real usability/value.

risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete bundle (worst-case: console not usable without missing HDMI/controller).

risks.risk: Hardware faults not visible in a still photo (HDMI output, USB ports, disc drive, controller issues).
risks.proof: Short video: connect to TV, show boot/home screen, test USB device, and (if disc version) insert a disc and show it loading.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully functional (worst-case: assume ports/disc drive may fail).

risks.risk: Thermal/repair history not verifiable remotely (fan/thermal paste/overheating).

risks.if_unproven: Price as potential overheating/needs service risk.

risks.risk: Storage capacity unknown (1TB vs 500GB) changes value.
risks.proof: Photo of Settings > Storage (or System Information) showing total storage.

risks.proof: Video of both controllers in-game showing analog movement and button presses; close-up of controller model label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers not guaranteed (worst-case: treat as unreliable/unincluded).
